flows.name: Log the day
flows.goal: Write today's log and add the progress photos.
acceptance: A log is saved offline and shows as submitted once it syncs.

flows.name: Run an inspection
flows.goal: Check each area against its checklist.
acceptance: Each failed item creates a corrective action.

flows.name: Report and follow an incident
flows.goal: Report an incident and follow its actions.
alternates: A serious incident also raises the escalation alert.
acceptance: An incident is reported the same day it happens.

flows.name: Close a corrective action
flows.goal: Record the fix for one action.
acceptance: A closed action keeps its photo and its date.

flows.name: Escalate a serious incident
flows.goal: Read the alert and check the open actions.
acceptance: The regional director sees each serious incident within the hour.

flows.name: Request a permit to work
flows.goal: Ask for a permit for one job.
alternates: A request for work at height goes to the safety officer first.
acceptance: A permit is never approved by the foreman who requested it.

flows.name: Approve a permit
flows.goal: Run the checks and approve or reject a permit.
acceptance: Each approval records who approved it and when.

flows.name: Review the approval trail
flows.goal: Check who approved the permits and read the weekly report.
acceptance: Every approval appears in the trail.

flows.name: Record an induction
flows.goal: Record a worker's induction before the first shift.
acceptance: A worker without a valid induction is not added to a shift.

flows.name: Check medical fitness
flows.goal: Check the fitness result of the workers on site.
acceptance: Only the safety officer and the worker see a medical result.

flows.name: See my certificates offline
flows.goal: Check the device and read your own certificates.
acceptance: The field app shows the queue even with no signal.

flows.name: Check subcontractor certificates
flows.goal: Check each crew's certificates before it starts.
acceptance: A crew with an expired certificate does not start.

flows.name: Upload subcontractor certificates
flows.goal: Upload the certificates of a crew.
acceptance: Each upload needs an expiry date.

flows.name: Register and inspect equipment
flows.goal: Add a machine and schedule its inspection.
acceptance: A machine that fails its inspection is locked.

flows.name: Work a punch list
flows.goal: Add the defects found on one floor.
acceptance: A punch item closes only after a photo is attached.

flows.name: Check the drawings
flows.goal: Find a drawing and confirm it is the current version.
acceptance: Only the current version is shown on site.

flows.name: Send the weekly safety report
flows.goal: Set the report and send it to the regional director.
acceptance: The report goes only to the regional director.

flows.name: Monthly regulator export
flows.goal: Build and check the monthly export.
acceptance: Every incident in the export has a status and a date.

flows.name: Auditor review
flows.goal: Read the records from the auditor portal.
acceptance: The auditor cannot change any record.

flows.name: Set up users and access
flows.goal: Sign in, set the language, add users and their site access.
acceptance: Each user sees only the sites their role allows.

card.question: What is the company, and what do you want the app to do?
card.why_we_ask: We need the company and the sites before anything else.

custom_input.placeholder: A safety app for our sites

card.intent: Capture the company, the sites and the main job of the app.
card.answer_spec: What the company does, where it works and what the app must do.

qa.custom_text: We are Grupo Cimbra Norte, a general contractor. We run about 14 sites at once in several countries: Mexico, Guatemala and Costa Rica. Supervisors need one app for daily logs, safety inspections and incidents, so we stop using paper and spreadsheets.

card.question: Who uses the app?
card.why_we_ask: The roles decide who sees which screen.

options.label: Site staff only
options.description: Only the people on the sites

options.label: Site staff, the office and subcontractors
options.description: Everyone who works on our projects

options.label: Site staff, the office, subcontractors and auditors

card.intent: Find out which people use the app.
card.answer_spec: Who uses the app on site and in the office.

card.question: Which languages and devices do people use?
card.why_we_ask: Language and device decide the screens and the offline design.

custom_input.placeholder: Spanish and English; phones on site

card.intent: Find the app languages and the devices on site.
card.answer_spec: Languages, and the devices people carry on site.

qa.custom_text: The app should be in Spanish and English. Field crews use Android phones and often have no signal on site.

card.question: What should the app not do?
card.why_we_ask: Exclusions keep the first version focused.
card.intent: Find what is out of scope.
card.answer_spec: What the company keeps elsewhere.

qa.custom_text: No payroll: payroll stays in our finance system.

card.question: Who can approve a permit to work?
card.why_we_ask: Approval rules decide the permit workflow.

options.label: The site supervisor
options.description: The supervisor signs for the crew

options.label: A safety officer
options.description: Only a safety officer approves work at height

options.label: The project manager
options.description: The project manager signs after the site

card.intent: Find who approves permits.
card.answer_spec: Who signs off work at height and other risky work.

card.question: What must be recorded for every incident?
card.why_we_ask: Incident rules set the report fields and the alerts.
card.intent: Find the incident rules.
card.answer_spec: Timing, photos, the people involved and escalation.

qa.custom_text: An incident must be reported on the same day it happens, with photos and the name of the person who was hurt. Serious incidents go to the regional director within the hour.

card.question: How do supervisors run a safety inspection?
card.why_we_ask: The inspection method sets the checklist screens.

options.label: A checklist on the phone, one per area
A paper form, typed later
options.description: Typed into the system at the end of the day

options.label: A walk-around with a photo only

card.intent: Find how inspections are done.
card.answer_spec: How the checklist is filled and by whom.

card.question: What happens when an inspection item fails?
card.why_we_ask: Failed items decide actions and locks.
card.intent: Find the consequences of a failed item.
card.answer_spec: Who owns the fix and what is locked until it is fixed.

qa.custom_text: A failed item needs a corrective action with an owner and a due date. Equipment that fails an inspection is locked until it is repaired.

card.question: Who sees the weekly safety report?
card.why_we_ask: The report audience decides the report screens and the access rules.

options.label: The regional director only
options.description: The regional directors read it every Monday

options.label: The regional director and the project manager

card.intent: Find who receives the weekly report.
card.answer_spec: Who receives the weekly report.

card.question: Who may work on a site, and what must a worker have?
card.why_we_ask: Induction and certificate rules block people from a shift.
card.intent: Find the rules for workers and crews.
card.answer_spec: Induction and certificate requirements.

qa.custom_text: A worker without a valid induction cannot be added to a shift. Subcontractor crews must have valid certificates before they start.

card.question: What personal data do you hold about workers?
card.why_we_ask: Sensitive data changes the security and privacy rules.
card.intent: Find the sensitive worker data and who may see it.
card.answer_spec: Which personal data, who sees it and where it is stored.

qa.custom_text: Identity documents and medical fitness certificates. The medical results are seen only by the safety officer and the worker. Worker documents stay in the country where the worker is employed.

options.label: No, the weekly report is enough
